Stock market live updates | Stay tuned to businessline for more

Tata Consumer Products: Q2 Profit dips to ₹242.81 crore in Q2FY27.

Dalmia Bharat: Standalone net profit at ₹15 cr in Q2

Bank of Maharashtra: Profit rises 41.4% to ₹2309.59 cr in Q2FY27

Ather Energy: Standalone profit at ₹1.50 cr in Q2

Tamilnad Mercantile Bank: Logs 42% y-o-y increase in Q2FY27 PAT

ITC Hotels’ net profit rose 17% y-o-y to ₹207.42 cr

Aegis Vopak Terminals: Logs standalone PAT at ₹37.32 cr

Indian Overseas Bank (IOB): Standalone PAT rises 56% y-o-y to ₹1912.42 cr

Supreme Industries: Standalone PAT up 44% to ₹279.25 crore in Q2

Macpower CNC Machines: Profit at ₹13.47 crore

Along with Europe, the UK, Asia Pacific, and emerging markets generally outperformed North America, where spending remained more selective and focused on business-critical initiatives

While 10% year on year rupee depreciation impacted it’s reported numbers, revenue in constant currency terms grew 11.2% to $235.2 million

Hospitality major ITC Hotels on Monday reported a roughly 52 per cent year-on-year increase in consolidated net profit to ₹202.65 crore for the second quarter of this fiscal year, supported by more than a 25 per cent y-o-y jump in gross revenue.

Shanthi Gears, a subsidiary of Tube Investments of India Ltd, reported a 27 per cent decrease in net profit to ₹15.7 crore for the second quarter ended September 2026, as against ₹21.5 crore for the same period last year.

Revenue from operations reached its highest-ever quarterly high at ₹803 crore, increasing 53% annually and 87% quarterly

Total Business grew by 27.25%, highest year on year growth since listing of the bank. Net Interest Income for the quarter stood at ₹807 Crore, a growth rate of 35.17% YoY

Higher depreciation and finance costs largely offset an increase in EBITDA. The net loss for the first half of FY27 stood at ₹105.4 crore, compared with ₹16.7 crore a year earlier

Tata Consumer Products, maker of Tata Tea, Tata Salt and Tata Sampann, reported a 16 per cent year-on-year increase in consolidated net profit attributable to shareholders, from ₹404.46 crore to ₹469.30 crore in the July–September 2026 quarter.

Indian Overseas Bank reported a 56 per cent YoY growth in net profit at ₹1,912 crore for the quarter ended September 2026 (Q2FY27) on the back of strong net interest income growth

The company had posted a net profit of ₹134.47 crore in the same period of the previous fiscal year, Eris Lifesciences Ltd said in a regulatory filing.

The hospitality sector player had posted a net profit of ₹133.29 crore during the corresponding July-September (Q2) period of the previous financial year.

Interest income of the bank rises 17% to ₹9,201 crore during the September quarter

Aequs reported standalone net profit of Rs 1.79 crore in Q2FY27 compared to Rs 4.06 crore in June 32026 quarter and Rs 1.68 million in Q2FY26.

“We achieved 4% YoYrevenue growth during the quarter on the back of volume growth and better realization. Demandchallenges in few of our key markets along with macro-economic cost headwinds impacted EBITDAfor the quarter. While the operating environment continues to remain challenging, we are hopefulthat positive momentum on cement prices and our consistent focus on cost optimization will helpmitigate cost pressures.”

Yatin Malhotra, Chief Financial Officer, Dalmia Bharat,

“India continues to demonstrate remarkable resilience despite global headwinds.Robust economic activity, supported by sustained public spending, drove broad-based growth.Cement demand too recorded healthy growth during the quarter, reinforcing my confidence in theindustry’s long-term prospects. In this backdrop, our capacity expansion plans remain firmly ontrack while we make strong progress on integration of Central assets. Looking ahead, we remainfocused on executing our strategic priorities, deepening our operational excellence andmaintaining financial discipline to deliver sustainable and superior returns for our stakeholders.”

- Puneet Dalmia, Managing Director & CEO, Dalmia Bharat

Dalmia Bharat reported standalone net profit of Rs 15 crore in Q2FY27 compared to Rs 23 crore in June 2026 quarter and Rs 14 crore in Q2FY26.

Board declared interim dividend of Rs 4 per share.

Sumitomo Chemical India reported standalone net profit of Rs 156 crore in Q2FY27 aganist Rs 177.89 crore in Q2FY26.

Q2FY27 earnings supported gains in several stocks, according to Abhinav Tiwari, Sr. Research Analyst at Bonanza.

Kotak Mahindra Bank rose over 2% after reporting a 29.5% YoY increase in standalone net profit. Dr Reddy’s Laboratories surged 7.51%, while Indian Overseas Bank gained nearly 6% after its net profit increased 56%. Ather Energy also rallied sharply following a turnaround in its quarterly performance.
